typeClosure.idDerivation: typeId = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256('efs2/type/1'), shape, keccak256(abi.encode(refTypes)), ruleId)); shape = the keccak256(utf8 name) listed per Type; ruleId = the MANDATORY (registration-time) acceptor's runtime codehash (0 for no acceptor); the additional policy acceptor is NOT part of the id; refTypes are the derived ids of the listed reference Types (ITEM before PAIR before QUOTE_J). Registration of an existing id reverts E_TYPE_EXISTS; a later policy activation (TypeRegistry.activate) changes the enforcing acceptor without changing the id.
typeClosure.vectorNote: vectors/profile-b.json remains the dcc7b94 vector: its Type ids are name hashes under the pinned profile and its actionsEncoded / acceptanceProfile / digest do NOT apply to the repaired source (derived ids). A new declared vector is owed after a build; do not retrofit the old one.
typeClosure.mandatoryVsPolicy: F5 (REPAIR.md): the registration-time acceptor is the Type's MANDATORY rule — it runs on every publish/reuse (codehash re-verified: E_ACCEPTOR_CODE) and its refusal E_REJECTED is final; TypeRegistry.activate installs an ADDITIONAL policy acceptor that must also accept (E_POLICY_REJECTED); activate(address(0)) = no additional policy, never no validation. Mandatory fixture rules are stateless or immutable-configured; the mutable MockAcceptor is policy-only. A codehash pins code, not mutable dependencies; stateful developer rules remain allowed in production when their dependency/basis semantics are explicit (no purity requirement is claimed).
typeClosure.payloadControlsVsMantissas: quote3000 / quote3100 are the 32-byte PAYLOAD CONTROLS (uint256 3000 / 3100), not mantissas. The joined fixture mantissas are 2_500_000_000 (QUOTE_A1) / 2_502_000_000 (QUOTE_A2) / 2_501_000_000 (QUOTE_B1) inside 160-byte QUOTE_J bodies. StrictQuoteAcceptor's cap (2_500_000_000) applies to the 32-byte uint256 value of a QUOTE body: both payload controls are below it; the explicit above-cap body of cell policy/activate is uint256 3_000_000_000 and is NOT a payload control.

matchedControl.statement: No measurement in this lab is a matched substitute for the fuller Files control (ebc7d54). The 32-byte/41-byte cells are hash-placement diagnostics (names are hashes), the label cells are a client-convention filename-retention baseline, and the joined cell covers sdk-fixture steps 1-6 only. A matched comparison requires labels (mandatory, exported/imported) and the joined journey integrated into one guarantee profile, which does not exist yet.
matchedControl.consequence: no B/C cost winner and no Files-create parity can be claimed from any row here
